SETUP_CODE.description: Invent a word and type it once — `blue-kettle-rain` is fine. It stops anyone who finds the address before you from claiming the site. It is **not** the password: the site asks you to choose that in the browser, afterwards.

DB.description: Holds the list of photographs — their order and their proportions. Not the pictures themselves.

IMAGES.description: Holds the photographs. About 600 of them fit in the free tier.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:worker && npm run verify:setup && npm run login:reset && npm run verify:admin
scripts.local: npm run build && npm run db:local && wrangler dev
scripts.local:reset: wrangler d1 execute justimages --local --command "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS images; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS settings; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS login_attempts; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS d1_migrations;" && npm run db:local
scripts.login:reset: wrangler d1 execute justimages --local --command "DELETE FROM login_attempts;"
scripts.node:start: npm run build && npm run node:build && node node/server.mjs
